sessions.title: Rest day
sessions.purpose: Absorb the training. Fitness is built while you recover.

structure.main: No training. A walk is fine.

sessions.title: Mobility & core
sessions.purpose: Active recovery: loosen hips, hamstrings and shoulders.

structure.main: Hip, hamstring and thoracic mobility; 3 rounds of plank, side plank and dead bugs.

sessions.title: Commute ride
sessions.purpose: Easy aerobic volume that fits your day.

structure.main: Ride to work and back at a conversational effort.

sessions.title: Upper body + abs
sessions.purpose: Shoulder and back strength for swimming; core for posture on the bike and run.

structure.main: 3×8–10 pull-ups/rows, push-ups, overhead press, face pulls; 3 rounds of abs

sessions.title: Lower body + abs
sessions.purpose: Leg and hip strength to stay injury-free and push harder on the bike.

structure.main: 3×6–8 squats, Romanian deadlifts, split squats, calf raises; 3 rounds of abs

sessions.title: Upper body (maintenance)
sessions.purpose: Keep strength without adding fatigue close to race day.

structure.main: 2×8 of the main lifts at a comfortable weight; light abs

sessions.title: Lower body (maintenance)
sessions.purpose: Keep strength without heavy legs for the key sessions.

structure.main: 2×6 squats and deadlifts at a comfortable weight; light abs

sessions.title: Easy swim
sessions.purpose: Loosen up and keep the feel for the water.

structure.main: Continuous easy freestyle; mix in backstroke if you like.

sessions.title: Technique swim
sessions.purpose: Efficiency is free speed: drills for catch, rotation and breathing.

structure.main: 6×50 drills (catch-up, fingertip drag, 6-kick switch) + 4×100 smooth

sessions.title: Endurance swim
sessions.purpose: Build the aerobic engine to swim 750 m without fading.

structure.main: 3–4×300 m steady with 30 s rest

sessions.title: CSS intervals
sessions.purpose: Raise your threshold swim pace — the pace you hold in a race.

structure.main: 8–12×100 m at CSS, 15 s rest

sessions.title: Race-pace swim
sessions.purpose: Rehearse 750 m at race effort so the start doesn't surprise you.

structure.main: 3×250 m at race pace, 30 s rest

sessions.title: Open-water swim
sessions.purpose: Practise sighting, wetsuit swimming and swimming straight.

structure.main: Continuous swim; sight every 6–8 strokes; 3–4 short surges to practise starts.

sessions.title: Short & sharp swim
sessions.purpose: Stay sharp while resting up for the race.

structure.main: 6×50 m at race pace, 20 s rest

sessions.title: Easy ride
sessions.purpose: Recovery spin.

structure.main: Flat route, light gears, high cadence.

sessions.title: Endurance ride
sessions.purpose: Aerobic base on the bike.

structure.main: Steady road ride; keep it conversational.

sessions.title: MTB trail ride
sessions.purpose: Aerobic volume and bike handling — and fun.

structure.main: Trail ride; keep climbs controlled, don't chase every Strava segment.

sessions.title: Brick: bike → run
sessions.purpose: Teach your legs to run straight off the bike.

structure.main: 2×12 min at tempo on the bike, then straight into a 10–15 min run at steady effort

targets.hr: Z3 on the bike, Z2–Z3 on the run

sessions.title: Brick: race simulation
sessions.purpose: Rehearse race day: pacing, transition and fuelling.

structure.main: 20 km at race effort, quick transition, 3–5 km run at race pace

sessions.title: Short brick
sessions.purpose: Stay sharp and rehearse transition while resting up.

structure.main: 20 min ride with 3×2 min at race effort, then a 10 min run with 3×30 s at race pace

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.purpose: Aerobic running without fatigue.

structure.main: Conversational pace throughout.

sessions.title: parkrun (easy)
sessions.purpose: Enjoy the community run at an easy effort.

structure.main: 5 km at a comfortable pace; finish feeling you could do more.

sessions.title: parkrun (tempo)
sessions.purpose: Sustained effort just below race pace — builds the 5 km engine.

structure.main: parkrun at a comfortably-hard effort (you can say a few words)

sessions.title: parkrun (race effort)
sessions.purpose: Practise running 5 km hard — a C-race in all but name.

structure.main: parkrun at race effort; even splits

sessions.title: Long easy run
sessions.purpose: Endurance without intensity.

structure.main: Steady and conversational; walk breaks are fine on hills.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.purpose: The backbone of running endurance.

structure.main: Steady Z2; last 10 min a little quicker if you feel good.

sessions.title: Run intervals
sessions.purpose: Raise top-end speed for the 5 km run.

structure.main: 5–6×3 min hard (Z4–Z5), 2 min jog

sessions.title: Race-pace run
sessions.purpose: Lock in the pace you'll run off the bike.

structure.main: 3×8 min at race pace, 2 min jog

sessions.title: Short run + strides
sessions.purpose: Keep the legs fresh and quick before race day.

structure.main: 15 min easy, then 4–6×20 s strides with full recovery
